notes.title: Win a Limited Edition Skogsrå pin!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40686742/cd1f40a74d84c7c77b8de98dc37e59b9312feaea.jpg[/img]

[h3][b][url=https://gleam.io/WqgrA/bramble-the-mountain-king-competition-pick-your-favourite-moment]HURRY - ONLY 2 DAYS LEFT ON THIS COMPETITION - ENTER NOW![/url][/b][/h3]

Hey everyone,

To celebrate surpassing an incredible [b]2,000 Reviews on Steam[/b] 🥳, we're giving away[b] limited edition Skogsrå pins[/b] to lucky winners!

To enter, all you need to do is [b]upload a screenshot of your favourite moment from Bramble: The Mountain King on Steam, Twitter, Instagram or Facebook[/b], with the hashtag [b]#BrambleMoment[/b], then add your post to our [b][url=https://gleam.io/WqgrA/bramble-the-mountain-king-competition-pick-your-favourite-moment]Gleam competition here.[/url][/b]

From strolling through the meadow to 'Den Blomstertid', to running for your life from the evil Näcken, everybody will have a moment from Bramble that is special to them. We want to know which moment is your favourite and why!

Let us know your favourite moment with your screenshots, and upload and tag them on Twitter. [b]Our competition closes on the 7th December 2023, 5pm GMT.[/b]

____________________________________________

[i][u][b]HOW TO ENTER:[/b][/u][/i]

[b]Instagram:[/b] Post your screenshot to Instagram with the hashtag #BrambleMoment, and enter this using the "Submit Media" button.

[b]Facebook:[/b] Post your screenshot to Facebook with the hashtag #BrambleMoment, and enter this using the "Submit Media" entry option.

[b]Twitter:[/b] Post your screenshot on Twitter with the hashtag #BrambleMoment, and enter by copying the link to this Tweet and submitting the URL using the "Submit URL" entry option.

[b]Steam:[/b] Upload your screenshot to the Steam Community Screenshot area ([b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=181142704]click here for more info on how to upload your screenshot to Steam Community Hub[/url][/b]), and enter by copying the link to this Screenshot (found in the top-left of screenshot window) and submitting the URL using the "Submit URL" entry option.

[h2][b][url=https://gleam.io/WqgrA/bramble-the-mountain-king-competition-pick-your-favourite-moment]CLICK HERE TO ENTER NOW!
[/url][/b][/h2]

____________________________________________

Not played yet? You can grab Bramble: The Mountain King discounted on Steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623940/Bramble_The_Mountain_King/

We can't wait to see what your favourite moment was! Good luck!

Until next time,
Your Dimfrost Studio and Merge Games

[i]Edit: We are aware of issues regarding entry submissions through Twitter, and users getting the message "Sorry, this media is temporarily disabled". In the meantime, we have opened up entries from Facebook and Instagram also.[/i]

notes.title: Bramble: The Mountain King is Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're very pleased to announce that [b]Bramble: The Mountain King is now VERIFIED ON STEAM DECK![/b]

[b][i]So, what does this mean?[/i][/b]

Valve's testing indicates that the game is fully functional on Steam Deck, and works great with the built-in controls and display.
[list]
[*] All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configuration
[*] This game shows Steam Deck controller icons
[*] In-game interface text is legible on Steam Deck
[*] This game's default graphics configuration performs well on Steam Deck
[/list]
We hope Steam Deck users enjoy playing Bramble: The Mountain King on Deck and dive deeper into the twisted land of Bramble.

Bramble: The Mountain King is available now on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623940/Bramble_The_Mountain_King/

notes.title: Patch Notes for PC - 21st June 2023
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've pushed a new patch live today for Bramble: The Mountain King on Steam. The reception to the game has been absolutely fantastic, and we thank everyone for playing and for the kind words relayed to the development team.

We hope these changes help fix these issues that some players have been facing!
___________________________________________________________________

- Fixed an issue where some players using keyboards were unable to complete the QTE’s that required you to push down on several keys at the same time

- Made it easier to climb walls and other surfaces

- Made it possible to climb on to “rocking boat” in Swamp level from the side where you detach the Bramble from it

- Addressed the confusion caused by the puzzle in the prince's room by removing the extra holes in the grandfather clock

- Made it easier to jump on the “floating boxes” in Swamp level

- Fixed a bug where the final boss would not advance to its second stage if you shot the flowers while they were closed

- Fixed a bug where the “flower monster” would not react to you if you reset the level in “Tuva”

- Fixed a bug where the flashbacks were not showing up if you died during the sequence in “Dream 3”

- Fixed a misspelling of a name in the credits

- Made it more clear where to climb in the “Butcher boss” area

- Fixed a bug where some bramble and the scepter from the final boss was visible after they were not supposed to

- Fixed a bug where the speed of the minecart in troll forest was dependent on your fps

- Fixed different collision issues

- Fixed a bug where the zombies would stop chasing you sometimes if you hit a collision box

- Fixed a bug where Lillemor would run in a circle if you skipped the belltower cinematic

- Made it easier for the gnomes to not get stuck at the last trap where you try to avoid the bear traps

- Fixed a bug where an ingredient could be falsely automatically added after you made an incorrect potion

- Made it more clear that gnomes were killed if hit by bear traps

- Added planks going into the swamp stealth part to lead the player towards the first hidden planks section

- Updated default settings for steam deck certification

___________________________________________________________________

notes.title: Patch Notes for PC - 10th May 2023
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've pushed a patch live today for Bramble: The Mountain King on Steam. The reception to the game has been absolutely fantastic, and we thank everyone for playing and for the kind words relayed to the development team.

However, we have had a few reports of issues that players have been facing, and wanted to work to fix these to better improve the general experience of all of our amazing players!

___________________________________________________________________

- Fix an issue where the game sometimes would not save, and upon resuming the game after closing it down the player’s progress would only be in Nearby Forest

- Fix an issue on steam deck and some PCs where the video on top of the lighthouse in Pesta did not play, and softlocks the player if it did not play. Now, the video might still not play on those machines, but in case it doesn’t play the video is skipped and the player can resume playing normally

- Fix an issue where the main menu would receive input while fading in, and the “New Game” button would be auto-focused. This would make players accidentally press the “New Game” button while the menu is fading in. Now, the menu should not be intractable during the fade-in, and the “Continue” button should be auto-focused instead if the player has a save file with progress 

- Improve the visibility of the hidden planks in the swamp by increasing the emissivity of the material

___________________________________________________________________

notes.title: PlayStation Demo Fest Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40686742/faf2e7ff23acce108d44501c8855f46b1bca683f.png[/img]

[h2]Bramble: The Mountain King launches updated “The Näcken’s Pond” demo on PlayStation 5![/h2]

Following the huge success of Bramble: The Mountain King’s demo on Steam, we have worked with Sony to bring the captivating demo to PlayStation. We’re so proud to be a part of [b]Sony’s PlayStation Demo Fest[/b] with Bramble: The Mountain King.

Now, PS5 users can download and play the demo, experiencing the wondrous world of Bramble and the menacing musician of the pond.

[h3][url=https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/EP1121-PPSA09426_00-0421111822902141]Add the demo to your PS5 library to download and play now![/url][/h3]

This new demo, referred to as [b]“The Story of the Näcken”[/b], also features a new in-game [b]Voice-Over[/b] and [b]bug fixes[/b] from the previous Steam version.

[b]Tune in to The Game Awards tonight to find out more![/b]

Make sure to download and play “The Story of the Näcken” demo on PlayStation 5! And if you haven’t tried out our Steam demo, you can still download and play this via the link below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623940/Bramble_The_Mountain_King/
